scope: Twenty unchanged canonical compiler routes; four explicitly audited named layout extensions. All retain exact canonical prompt, ART_KIT and DiscoveryAtlas style input, with recorded composition/source-visibility additions. Painting requests are not observed anatomy. No runtime, registered pack, reference pool or native qualification.

entries.name: Clam
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: two connected gape-separated shell valves with concentric growth rings, broad visible mantle edge, a pale ventral muscular-foot-shaped projection and two separate hollow posterior siphon openings. No head or invented eyes. The true dorsal hinge/ligament is partly obscured by the upper valve in this oblique view; an exact observable hinge coordinate is for independent review, not inferred from shell tips. Foot proportions and soft-tissue continuity require biological review. Source is not authoring or D31 admission.

entries.name: Prawn
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: true dorsal-looking body, two visible eyes, serrated rostrum, abdomen sections and five-part tail fan. Five walking-leg endpoints appear on each side with much clearer thoracic emergence than predecessor; fine anterior roots still need independent tracing. Additional short antennules and abdominal swimmerets are retained. Two long antennae approach the right canvas edge closely, leaving a likely framing refusal. Pale seam-like lines at thorax/abdomen and exact walking-leg morphology remain visual holds; no measured reference admission.

entries.name: Shrimp
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: dorsal-looking shrimp with five visible walking-leg endpoints and thoracic emergence on each side, two stalked eyes, serrated rostrum, short antennules, long antennae, abdomen sections, swimmerets and intact tail fan. Fine roots and exact swimmeret counts need independent source tracing; no biological completeness is inferred. The right antenna tips lie very close to the edge, likely failing the margin. Long straightened dorsal posture differs from the canonical curved-abdomen cue; retain that identity/view hold.

entries.name: Snail
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: coiled spiral shell, complete broad foot, exactly two long upper stalks and two shorter lower projections. Dark tips appear on the lower feelers as well as the upper eyes and require anatomical review. A small dark crease beneath the head may be an oral slit, but the mouth boundary is not independently unambiguous at this angle; reference admission remains held pending inspection. No third lower projection or large cartoon circular mouth is apparent.

entries.name: Impala
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: both full ear silhouettes are separately visible in a shallow head turn, two ringed lyre-shaped horns, four distinct hooves/leg shafts and continuous short tufted tail. The white rump carries two dark vertical stripe markings; hind-hoof dark tufts are visible. Far upper foreleg remains partly hidden by the chest. No apparent fifth limb. Improved ear exposure is observed; semantic ownership and motion remain unmeasured.

entries.name: Dog
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: four separate paw ends, continuous high plumed tail in an open arch, black nose and white/brown coat. Ears are naturally folded rather than the earlier erect-ear depiction; far ear is partially obscured by the head and crown fur. Dense chest and upper-leg feathering remains. The tail no longer forms a closed loop over the back, but classifier behavior is not measured; identity and proximal ownership remain for review.

entries.name: Wolverine
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: four separate clawed paw endpoints, heavy shaggy body, short visibly continuous bushy tail and pale sweeping stripe along the visible flank. Far ear is still a small crown tip; fur covers proximal roots. Near/far forelegs are now distinguishable below the chest, but upper ownership remains unmeasured. Tail remains naturally short, not stretched to match a reference.

entries.name: Badger
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: four separately visible clawed feet, broad low body, coarse fur, clear pale central facial stripe bordered by dark patches and short attached tail. Near ear is visible and far ear only a small tip. Dense skirt still overlaps upper leg emergence. No apparent extra limb; fringe ownership, short-tail transfer and motion remain held pending scoring.

entries.name: Beaver
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: four foot endpoints with visible hind-foot webbing, attached flat scaled paddle tail, orange incisors and bulky brown fur. Near small ear is clear; far ear is not distinctly exposed, so the requested two-ear visibility correction is not established. Fur still obscures proximal leg emergence. Tail is separated from feet; semantic ownership and biological proportions remain held.

entries.name: Fishing Cat
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: stocky short-legged spotted cat, four separate paw endpoints/lower legs, neck stripes and short banded tail. Near ear is clear but far ear is a partial tip. Tail reads very short and merits species-proportion review. Far proximal roots remain hidden beneath body fur; no fifth limb apparent, and no fit or motion claim.

entries.name: African Wild Dog
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: four distinct paw ends and long leg shafts, two very large rounded ears, irregular black/tan/white coat patches and full continuous white-tipped tail. Near/far upper forelegs and rear roots partly overlap naturally; the large ear proportions merit biological review. No apparent fifth leg, but exact ownership and native motion are unmeasured.

entries.name: Spotted Hyena
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: four separate paw endpoints, sloping back with higher forequarters, coarse tan spotted coat, dark muzzle, bushy attached tail and two visible ears. Ears appear elongated/pointed compared with the requested rounded form and remain an identity hold. Fur covers upper roots; no extra limb is evident. No acceptance or claimed solver correction.

entries.name: Aardvark
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: two long attached ears, tubular pig-like snout, thick continuous tapering tail and four separate feet with digging claws. Exact fore/hind toe counts are not all equally visible; do not infer hidden digits. Fur and body still occlude far upper limb roots. Tail/snout leave relatively narrow side margins for measurement. Proportions, digits and independent limb ownership remain held.

entries.name: Okapi
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: two clearly separate large ears, four whole hooves and leg shafts, chestnut body, striped hindquarters/upper rear legs, white lower-leg bands and continuous tufted tail. Two short male-like ossicones are visible. Body reads rounded and neck/limb proportions merit biological review. Far proximal limb roots are partially hidden; no claim of complete anatomical fit.

entries.name: Pronghorn
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: four hooves and leg shafts, white rump and underside, throat bands, both upright ears and a small naturally short white tail protruding at the rump. Only one forked horn silhouette is independently clear; the far horn is hidden or merged and cannot be inferred as separately painted. Tail tip is distinct but close to the rump. Proximal roots and species proportions remain held.

entries.name: Springbok
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: two full ear silhouettes, two ringed curved horns, four hoof endpoints, dark flank band above white belly, face stripes and small continuous black-tipped tail. Far proximal foreleg remains behind the chest/near leg. Tail stays naturally short; no invisible segments are invented. Pattern visibility is observed, but reference transfer and motion remain unmeasured.

entries.name: Duiker
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: small brown arched-backed antelope form, four separate hoof endpoints, two small horns and genuine short white-tipped tail extending from the rump. Near ear is clear; far ear/root overlaps the horn/crown and is not independently complete. Short tail remains partly adjacent to rump fur. Lower legs are distinct but upper roots partly occluded; no full fit claim.

entries.name: Serow
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: coarse shaggy coat and throat hair, two short backward horns, four separated hoof endpoints and a short attached tail. Only one complete ear silhouette is clear; far ear is obscured. Coat hangs over proximal limb roots and may still need manual ownership. Natural short tail was preserved rather than lengthened; identity/proportion and moving-paint review remain pending.

entries.name: Bison
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: four separated hoof endpoints and lower legs, real heavy shoulder hump, dense beard/front coat, two horns and full attached tail/tuft separated from rear feet. Only the near ear is unambiguously visible; far ear remains obscured. Hanging forequarter fur still overlaps upper limbs and forms deep fringe; this is retained as an ownership limitation, not claimed repaired.

entries.name: Warthog
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: four distinct hoof endpoints/leg shafts, two visible ears, facial warts, two prominent upward tusks, coarse mane and complete upright tufted tail. A narrow hair-like contour along the rear rump and fine mane tips need ownership review. Far proximal legs remain partly hidden; tusk symmetry and proportions remain biological review items. No native or static acceptance.

entries.name: Caribou
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: four separate broad hooves/leg shafts, shaggy pale neck, mottled brown body and short pale tail. Large palmate antlers overlap above the head; exact antler branch ownership and species proportions need review. Near ear is clear, far ear partly hidden under antler/crown. No fifth leg is apparent, but neck fringe and far upper roots remain held.

entries.name: Yak
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: four separate hoof endpoints below the genuine long dense coat, two curved horns, heavy shoulder profile and full long bushy tail. The coat hides most upper/lower leg paths; four complete leg chains cannot be asserted merely from four hooves. Only the near ear is clear. Natural hair was preserved; reference ownership and any unassigned-paint repair are unmeasured.

entries.name: Bactrian Camel
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: two distinct humps, shaggy neck/body, four separate padded two-toed foot ends and lower limbs, and short attached hairy tail. The near ear is visible but the far ear is obscured by the crown. Hanging neck/chest coat still obscures proximal forelimbs. No extra hump or limb is apparent; exact limb root ownership and foot proportions remain for author review.

entries.name: Buffalo
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original inspected: four separate cloven hoof endpoints, broad connected horn boss and two curled horns, dark hide and complete thin tail ending in a tuft separated from rear legs. Near ear is clear and far ear hidden by head/horn. Far upper limb roots remain partly occluded. Lower abdomen contains a small natural anatomy projection that must not be counted as an invented fifth limb or silently discarded; source-specific interpretation remains held.
